title: Eight Point Sets
statementMd:
Gerald is very particular to eight point sets. He thinks that any decent eight point set must consist of all pairwise intersections of three distinct integer vertical straight lines and three distinct integer horizontal straight lines, except for the average of these nine points. In other words, there must be three integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *x*_{3}$ and three more integers $*y*_{1}, *y*_{2}, *y*_{3}$, such that $*x*_{1} < *x*_{2} < *x*_{3}$, $*y*_{1} < *y*_{2} < *y*_{3}$ and the eight point set consists of all points $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*j*})$ ($1 ≤ *i*, *j* ≤ 3$), except for point $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$.

You have a set of eight points. Find out if Gerald can use this set?

## Input

The input consists of eight lines, the $*i*$-th line contains two space-separated integers $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$). You do not have any other conditions for these points.

## Output

In a single line print word "`respectable`", if the given set of points corresponds to Gerald's decency rules, and "`ugly`" otherwise.
statementZhMd:
Gerald 对八点集有着非常严格的要求。他认为，任何合格的八点集都必须由三条互不相同的整数竖直直线和三条互不相同的整数水平直线的所有两两交点组成，但去掉这九个点的平均点。换句话说，必须存在三个整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *x*_{3}$ 和另外三个整数 $*y*_{1}, *y*_{2}, *y*_{3}$，满足 $*x*_{1} < *x*_{2} < *x*_{3}$、$*y*_{1} < *y*_{2} < *y*_{3}$，并且这八个点集由所有点 $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*j*})$（$1 ≤ *i*, *j* ≤ 3$）组成，但不包括点 $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$。

现在给你一个包含八个点的集合。请判断 Gerald 是否会认可这个集合。

## 输入格式

输入包含八行，第 $*i*$ 行包含两个由空格分隔的整数 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*y*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$）。对于这些点没有其他限制。

## 输出格式

如果给定的点集符合 Gerald 的要求，则在一行中输出单词 "`respectable`"，否则输出 "`ugly`"。
